arcsExpected.name: stable_healthy
arcsExpected.description: mark 一直健康,寿命未走完

arcsExpected.name: natural_death_long_life
arcsExpected.description: 长期健康 mark,寿命走完直接 DEAD,无趋势恶化

arcsExpected.name: remote_good
arcsExpected.description: 偏远但表现好 (转化率高),续命系数生效但流量低

arcsExpected.name: sick_death_full
arcsExpected.description: 健康 → 向下急转 → 救命期 → 病危 → 心跳 → 死亡

arcsExpected.name: recovered_via_heart_starter
arcsExpected.description: 健康 → 向下急转进救命期 → 强心剂触发 → 回 HEALTHY

arcsExpected.name: in_suspicious_unresolved
arcsExpected.description: 近期向下急转,救命期未结束就 simulate 终止

arcsExpected.name: new_mark_burst
arcsExpected.description: 新 mark 第 1-2 天大量 like burst (向上急转),维持 HEALTHY

arcsExpected.name: sudden_viral
arcsExpected.description: 原本冷门,突然 viral 流量爆增

arcsExpected.name: controversial_50_50
arcsExpected.description: 长期 50:50 争议,不急转,维持 HEALTHY (Case R)。期望:从未触发 SUSPICIOUS。

arcsExpected.name: chronic_decline
arcsExpected.description: 不急转的慢性恶化,转化率慢慢降低,可能仍 healthy 或自然老死

arcsExpected.name: commercial_fake_ad
arcsExpected.description: 商业广告 mark,真实用户多个 fake_ad report,加速病死

arcsExpected.name: dislike_storm_recovered
arcsExpected.description: 集中 dislike report,进 SUSPICIOUS 但严重度低,后续 like 容易回 HEALTHY

arcsExpected.name: natural_death_revivable
arcsExpected.description: 历史好但后期低互动,寿命走完可远程复活

arcsExpected.name: sick_death_on_site_only
arcsExpected.description: 病死后历史一般,远程复活资格不够,必须到场复活

arcsExpected.name: sick_death_not_revivable
arcsExpected.description: 病死且历史差,无法复活,用户须新建

arcsExpected.name: brigade_then_recovery
arcsExpected.description: brigade 攻击进 SUSPICIOUS,后续真用户 like 触发强心剂,旧 report 被消化

arcsExpected.name: seasonal_real_calendar
arcsExpected.description: 季节性 mark (用真实日历)

arcsExpected.name: clean_mark_single_fake_ad
arcsExpected.description: 长期干净 (5000 like 0 report) + 1 条最严重 fake_ad,1 条不构成趋势,维持 HEALTHY

arcsExpected.name: lifespan_expired_in_suspicious
arcsExpected.description: 寿命末期向下急转进 SUSPICIOUS,无人来续命,寿命走完即 DEAD

arcsExpected.name: late_burst_extends_life
arcsExpected.description: 寿命末期向下急转进 SUSPICIOUS,但末期 burst like 续命 + 触发强心剂,回 HEALTHY

arcsExpected.name: doc_warning_brigade_attacked
arcsExpected.description: DOC 官方雪崩警告被多人集中 report,算法不豁免照常进 SUSPICIOUS

arcsExpected.name: second_round_decline
arcsExpected.description: 第一轮强心剂回 HEALTHY 后,新一轮负向再次进 SUSPICIOUS → DEAD

arcsExpected.name: mixed_severity_decline
arcsExpected.description: 远期纯 dislike,近期混合 fake_ad + info_mismatch + dislike,严重度组合加速死亡

arcsExpected.name: heartbeat_traffic_cutoff
arcsExpected.description: mark 进 HEARTBEAT 后流量切断, 时钟 A 不冰冻继续流失,寿命走完仍 DEAD

arcsExpected.name: second_generation_after_revival
arcsExpected.description: 复活后二代 mark 继续被新陌生人 like,凭实力续命,维持 HEALTHY
